Every accepted extracted mention retains its original source anchor.
Printed debit is exactly 18.00 and printed available balance is 82.00.
OCR candidates are unreviewed; retain the source image and bounding region.
Reject the OCR amount error until reviewed against the original.
Correcting the amount invalidates current dependent findings, not previous report bytes.
Shared name/reference digits do not erase conflicting dates or namespace differences.
Reversal restores identities while retaining the audit trail.
Two copied sources count as one origin group.
Confidence, extraction quality and source independence remain separate fields.
Use the address and merchant validity intervals applicable to the transaction date.
A nearby branch is not automatically the correct branch.
Online and ambiguous purchases remain unresolved in the location denominator.
Both legitimate same-day purchases survive duplicate review.
The overlapping row is reviewable and source-linked.
An explicitly paired transfer is excluded from combined external flow.
Refunds retain positive signs; AUD and USD totals remain separate.
CI replay never contacts these example domains.
A new identifier leads to a further relevant source within the declared budgets.
This replay cannot satisfy the live broad-discovery gate.
Archive traversal, unexpected messages and local/link-local destinations are denied.
Collected scripts never execute in the privileged interface.
Restart does not publish duplicate observations.
Migration failure leaves a usable workspace and referenced originals.
Previous report bytes remain unchanged after correction.
